sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER RIDGE WILL BUILD OVER THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS IN WAKE OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING EWD THROUGH ONTARIO. SERIES OF VORTICITY MAXIMA WILL ROTATE ALONG PERIPHERY OF THE UPPER RIDGE INCLUDING THE NRN PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY. ONE SUCH FEATURE LOCATED OVER NWRN WY AS OF EARLY THIS MORNING WILL ADVANCE INTO CNTRL ND SUNDAY AFTERNOON. AT THE SURFACE A COLD FRONT WILL CONTINUE EWD THROUGH SERN CANADA AND NRN GREAT LAKES IN ASSOCIATION WITH PROGRESSIVE TROUGH...WHILE TRAILING PORTION OF THIS BOUNDARY LIFTS NWD THROUGH THE DAKOTAS.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS THROUGH UPPER MS VALLEY AREA
sections.text: A CORRIDOR OF RICHER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE WITH UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 DEWPOINTS WILL PERSIST IN VICINITY OF RETREATING FRONT FROM THE UPPER MS VALLEY INTO THE DAKOTAS. STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND DIABATIC WARMING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG MLCAPE ALONG MOIST AXIS FROM MN INTO NRN SD...SRN ND AND ERN MT DURING THE DAY. THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR SURFACE BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN ZONE OF FRONTAL CONVERGENCE FROM NRN SD INTO SRN ND...POSSIBLY AIDED BY THE PROGRESSIVE IMPULSE. WARM TEMPERATURES WITH EML PLUME /700 MB TEMPERATURES FROM 12-14C/ ALONG WITH MODEST FORCING SUGGEST STORM COVERAGE WILL PROBABLY REMAIN ISOLATED. WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR FROM 35-40 KT AND 2500-3000 J/KG MLCAPE...ANY STORMS THAT DEVELOP WILL LIKELY BECOME SUPERCELLULAR WITH A THREAT OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. STORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE DURING THE EVENING AND OVERNIGHT OVER ND WITHIN ZONE OF STRENGTHENING WARM ADVECTION AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND...BUT AT LEAST A SMALL WINDOW WILL EXIST FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES BEFORE THE BOUNDARY LAYER BEGINS TO DECOUPLE AND STORMS GROW UPSCALE. ACTIVITY WILL SHIFT E

sections.title: GREAT LAKES AREA
sections.text: A FEW STORMS COULD DEVELOP WITHIN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY AHEAD OF FRONT OVER THE GREAT LAKES REGION WHERE 30-40 KT VERTICAL SHEAR WILL EXIST. HOWEVER...WEAK FORCING AND DRY MID-LEVEL THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES SUGGEST STORM COVERAGE WILL PROBABLY REMAIN VERY ISOLATED. THIS AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...AND A SLIGHT RISK MAY BE INTRODUCED IF IT BECOMES APPARENT STORM COVERAGE WILL BE MORE THAN CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED. ..DIAL/ROGERS.. 07/31/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: DOMINANT SRN/CNTRL U.S. ANTICYCLONE WILL BUILD FARTHER N ACROSS THE NRN PLNS AND CANADIAN PRAIRIES THIS PERIOD IN WAKE OF SLOWLY PROGRESSIVE LOW/TROUGH OVER NRN ONT...AND AHEAD OF POSITIVE-TILT TROUGH OVER BC. FARTHER S...A SERIES OF VORTICITY MAXIMA WILL MOVE ENE FROM THE NRN GRT BASIN AND NRN RCKYS INTO THE NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY...IN BELT OF ENHANCED FLOW ON THE IMMEDIATE NW/N SIDE OF THE ANTICYCLONE. ONE SUCH DISTURBANCE NOW OVER SE MT/NRN WY SHOULD REACH CNTRL ND BY AFTN. AT LWR LVLS...COLD FRONT ATTENDANT TO THE ONT TROUGH WILL CONTINUE E ACROSS SE CANADA AND NRN GRT LKS...WHILE THE WRN PART OF THE BOUNDARY REDEVELOPS NWD ACROSS THE DAKOTAS AS A WARM FRONT IN RESPONSE TO PERSISTENT LEE TROUGHING OVER THE HIGH PLNS.

sections.title: NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY THIS AFTN THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: A CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY RICH MOISTURE /WITH PW AOA 1.50 INCHES AND SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPR 60S TO NEAR 70 F/ WILL PERSIST INVOF STALLING FRONT OVER THE DAKOTAS AND UPR MS VLY TODAY. SFC HEATING AND CONTINUING PRESENCE OF STEEP MID LVL LAPSE RATES OVER THE REGION SHOULD YIELD MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY...WITH SBCAPE OF 3000-4000 J/KG EXPECTED FROM SRN ND/NRN SD EWD INTO SRN MN...AND VALUES TO PERHAPS 2000 J/KG IN FAR ERN MT. GIVEN THE ABOVE INSTABILITY...AND THE PRESENCE OF AT LEAST WEAK LOW LVL LIFT ALONG THE FRONT...THERE WILL EXIST A LOW PROBABILISTIC RISK FOR DIURNAL STORM DEVELOPMENT. THIS POTENTIAL APPEARS TO BE GREATEST OVER NRN SD AND SRN ND...WHERE MODEST LARGE SCALE ASCENT WILL OCCUR AHEAD OF WY/MT IMPULSE. BUT EML CAP /WITH 700 MB TEMP AROUND FROM 12-14C/ AND ABSENCE OF MORE SUBSTANTIAL FORCING FOR ASCENT SUGGEST THAT STORM COVERAGE SHOULD REMAIN ISOLD. ANY SUSTAINED ACTIVITY THAT DOES FORM SHOULD BE IN THE FORM OF SUPERCELLS GIVEN 35-40 KT WNWLY DEEP SHEAR AND SIZABLE CAPE. THESE WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND. STORM COVERAGE SHOULD INCREASE TNGT THROUGH EARLY MON OVER THE NRN PLNS AS SSWLY LLJ AND WAA/MOISTURE TRANSPORT SUBSTANTIALLY STRENGTHEN DOWNST

sections.title: GRT LKS THIS AFTN
sections.text: WDLY SCTD TO SCTD AFTN STORMS COULD FORM IN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY AHEAD OF COLD FRONT OVER THE GRT LKS TODAY...WHERE 30-40 KT NWLY DEEP SHEAR WILL EXIST. HOWEVER...LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE WEAK AS MAIN UPR IMPULSE PASSES WELL TO THE NORTH IN ONT...AND LOW LVL CONVERGENCE WILL REMAIN WEAK. A FEW CORRIDORS ULTIMATELY MAY EVOLVE THAT YIELD A LOCALLY ENHANCED RISK FOR DMGG WIND AND/OR MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. BUT CONFIDENCE IN THE LOCATION OF SUCH ACTIVITY ATTM REMAINS UNCERTAIN...AND A POSSIBLE UPGRADE OF PARTS OF THE REGION TO SLGT RISK WILL BE DEFERRED TO LATER OTLKS.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: HI PW VALUES COUPLED WITH STRONG SFC HEATING AND VERY WEAK DEEP WIND FIELDS MAY YIELD ISOLD WET MICROBURSTS OVER PARTS OF FL AND THE SERN STATES. ISOLD DMGG WIND GUSTS ALSO MAY OCCUR WITH STORMS OVER PARTS OF THE GRT BASIN AND RCKYS AS MID/UPR LVL MOISTURE SPREADS NWD ON WRN FRINGE OF PLNS ANTICYCLONE. ..CORFIDI/COHEN.. 07/31/2011

sections.title: NRN PLAINS INTO UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: THOUGH MIDLEVEL HEIGHTS WILL RISE THROUGH THE D1 PERIOD...MORNING WATER VAPOR IMAGERY AND 12Z MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATE A WEAK VORTICITY MAXIMUM OVER ERN MT WHICH WILL CREST RIDGE AXIS ACROSS ND TODAY. IN THE LOW LEVELS...SURFACE FRONT CURRENTLY FROM ERN MT ACROSS NRN SD WILL LIFT NWD IN RESPONSE TO THE DEEPENING AND SUBSEQUENT EWD PROGRESSION OF LEE CYCLONE FROM CNTRL AB INTO SK. THE COMBINATION OF THE WEAK IMPULSE AND LOW-LEVEL WAA N OF SURFACE FRONT WILL SERVE AS THE FOCI FOR ISOLATED-WIDELY SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT ACROSS NRN SD AND ND. EML AND ASSOCIATED STEEP LAPSE RATE PLUME OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS WILL SPREAD EWD ATOP FRONTAL ZONE AND A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...CONTRIBUTING TO AFTERNOON MLCAPE APPROACHING 3000-4500 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY WILL COINCIDE WITH VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH 35-45 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...RESULTING IN A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES. STRENGTHENING NOCTURNAL LLJ WILL LIKELY SUPPORT UPSCALE GROWTH OF DIURNAL STORMS INTO AN MCS WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL SPREADING EWD/SEWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE DAKOTAS INTO WRN MN TON

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: 12Z MHX/CHS SOUNDINGS SAMPLED A QUITE MOIST AIR MASS WITH PW VALUES AROUND TWO INCHES AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 75-80 F. DAYTIME HEATING OVER THE COASTAL PLAINS COUPLED WITH THIS MOISTURE WILL YIELD A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT BY AFTERNOON MLCAPE OF AROUND 3000 J/KG. DEVELOPING STORMS OVER THE NC PIEDMONT ARE EXPECTED TO INTENSIFY WHILE MOVING EWD/SEWD WITH ADDITIONAL TSTMS ANTICIPATED ALONG SEA BREEZE. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MULTIPLE STORM CLUSTERS IS PROBABLE WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF MAINLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG/S OF SURFACE FRONT EXTENDING FROM THE CNTRL PLAINS INTO SERN STATES...AS WELL AS WITHIN POLEWARD MOISTURE SURGE ALONG WRN EDGE OF MIDLEVEL RIDGE OVER THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST. ..MEAD/GARNER.. 07/31/2011

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS TO UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY
sections.text: WITH ONGOING SURFACE BASED SEVERE TSTMS IN NORTHWEST SD EARLY THIS EVENING...ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR THE REMAINDER OF THE EVENING EITHER SIDE OF A WARM FRONT THAT ANGLES NORTHWEST-SOUTHEASTWARD FROM SOUTHERN ND TO SOUTH-CENTRAL MN. EXTREME INSTABILITY...AS PER THE 00Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM BISMARCK WITH 5500 J/KG MLCAPE...AND STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WILL EASILY SUPPORT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF POTENTIALLY VERY LARGE HAIL. A TORNADO THREAT EXISTS AS WELL...ESPECIALLY THROUGH MID/PERHAPS LATE EVENING WITH ANY STORMS DEVELOPING NEAR/INTERACTING WITH THE WARM FRONT. OTHERWISE...WITH AID OF A NOCTURNALLY INCREASING LOW LEVEL JET...STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY GROW UPSCALE/PROPAGATE EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD WITH A HEIGHTENED DAMAGING WIND THREAT ACROSS THE EASTERN DAKOTAS INTO MN.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST STATES
sections.text: ISOLATED/POTENTIALLY DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE...MAINLY IN THE SHORT TERM ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CAROLINAS/GA. ..GUYER.. 08/01/2011
